tier_should.rationale: Large, well-executed RCT shows sizable health and economic gains from untargeted CBT. However, short 2–3 month horizon and heavy reliance on self-reports weaken generalizability and mechanism claims, tempering top-general appeal; strong fit for leading field journals.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authors, clean design, policy relevance, and development-health crossover increase odds of top field outlet; absence of long-run outcomes and objective measures may limit top-five general placement.
